svg.title: Six blades, one aperture
svg.desc: Six repeated edges shape a single opening. Hatching identifies one visible blade.

svg.title: A monogram in the void
svg.desc: An M is defined by the transparent space within a hatched field; its straight stems and surrounding margin follow the same unit.

svg.title: A keyboard, in detail
svg.desc: Two cropped rows reveal the keyboard’s construction: one key pitch and a quarter-unit stagger. Dashed continuations keep the focus on the spacing rule.

svg.title: The shape between circles
svg.desc: Two equal circular regions reveal an unhatched lens where their boundaries overlap.

svg.title: One edge, two cells
svg.desc: A selected hexagonal cell shares each of its walls with the surrounding six cells.

svg.title: Over and under
svg.desc: One warp and one weft reveal the alternating rule that holds a weave together.
